mapper.select: /* selectMyPendingJoinApplication */ select ja.application_id ,ja.guild_id ,g.guild_name ,ja.user_id ,ja.status ,ja.crt_date from GUILD_JOIN_APPLICATION ja left outer join GUILD g on ja.guild_id = g.guild_id where ja.user_id = #{sess_user_id} and ja.status = 'PENDING' order by ja.crt_date desc limit 1

/* selectJoinApplicationDetail */ select ja.application_id ,ja.guild_id ,g.guild_name ,ja.user_id ,tu.user_nm as user_name ,ja.status ,ja.message ,ja.reject_reason ,ja.crt_date from GUILD_JOIN_APPLICATION ja left outer join GUILD g on ja.guild_id = g.guild_id left outer join SYS_USER tu on ja.user_id = tu.user_id where ja.application_id = CAST(#{application_id} AS BIGINT)
